title: Christ's Example of Humility, Lights in the World

questions.question: Complete Paul's joy by being of the same mind, having the same love, being in full ____ and of one mind.
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:2 (ESV): "complete my joy by being of the same mind, having the same love, being in full accord and of one mind."

questions.question: Do nothing from selfish ambition or conceit, but in ____ count others more significant than yourselves.
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:3 (ESV): "Do nothing from selfish ambition or conceit, but in humility count others more significant than yourselves."

questions.question: Have this mind among yourselves, which is yours in Christ Jesus, who, though he was in the form of God, did not count ____ with God a thing to be grasped,
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:5-6 (ESV): "Have this mind among yourselves, which is yours in Christ Jesus, who, though he was in the form of God, did not count equality with God a thing to be grasped,"

questions.question: Instead of grasping equality with God, what did Jesus do?
options: Emptied himself, by taking the form of a servant
Preached the gospel to the poor
questions.correctAnswer: Emptied himself, by taking the form of a servant
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:7 (ESV): "but emptied himself, by taking the form of a servant, being born in the likeness of men."

questions.question: And being found in human form, he humbled himself by becoming obedient to the point of ____, even death on a cross.
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:8 (ESV): "And being found in human form, he humbled himself by becoming obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross."

questions.question: Therefore God has highly exalted him and bestowed on him the ____ that is above every name,
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:9 (ESV): "Therefore God has highly exalted him and bestowed on him the name that is above every name,"

questions.question: so that at the name of Jesus every ____ should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:10 (ESV): "so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,"

questions.question: and every ____ confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:11 (ESV): "and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father."

questions.question: Therefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, so now, not only as in my presence but much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:12 (ESV): "Therefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, so now, not only as in my presence but much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling,"

questions.question: For it is ____ who works in you, both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:13 (ESV): "for it is God who works in you, both to will and to work for his good pleasure."

questions.question: Do all things without ____ or disputing.
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:14 (ESV): "Do all things without grumbling or disputing,"

questions.question: That you may be blameless and innocent, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and twisted generation, among whom you shine as ____ in the world,
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:15 (ESV): "that you may be blameless and innocent, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and twisted generation, among whom you shine as lights in the world,"

questions.question: Paul hopes to send ____ to them soon, because he has "no one like him, who will be genuinely concerned for your welfare."
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:19-20 (ESV): "I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon... For I have no one like him, who will be genuinely concerned for your welfare."

questions.question: Who was Paul's brother and fellow worker and fellow soldier, and their messenger and minister to Paul's need, who had been ill near to death?
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:25-27 (ESV): "I have thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus my brother and fellow worker... Indeed he was ill, near to death. But God had mercy on him..."

questions.question: Paul tells them to receive Epaphroditus in the Lord with all joy, and honor such men, for he nearly died for the ____ of Christ.
questions.explanation: Philippians 2:29-30 (ESV): "So receive him in the Lord with all joy, and honor such men, for he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to complete what was lacking in your service to me."

key_verse_text: Have this mind among yourselves, which is yours in Christ Jesus, who, though he was in the form of God, did not count equality with God a thing to be grasped, but emptied himself, by taking the form of a servant, being born in the likeness of men. And being found in human form, he humbled himself by becoming obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross.
